name: UI：生图节点-输出模式切换验证(单图/打包)及比例尺寸联动
description: 验证生图节点输出模式Radio切换(拆分成单图给下游↔多张图打包在一起)、生图比例Select选项枚举、图片尺寸Select选项枚举、切换后保存持久化

steps.description: 打开含生图节点的策略详情页
验证生图详情页已加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const allEls = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t === '生图' && el.children.length === 0) { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t.includes('生图') && el.children.length <= 2 && el.closest('[class*=node], [class*=Node], [class*=card], [class*=Card]')) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const radioInfo = radios.map(r => { const label = (r.textContent || '').trim(); const checked = !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked'); const value = r.querySelector('input[type=radio]')?.value || ''; return { label, checked, value }; }); const defaultChecked = radioInfo.find(r => r.checked); return { open: true, radioCount: radios.length, radios: radioInfo, defaultChecked: defaultChecked ? defaultChecked.label : null }; })()
steps.description: 检查输出模式Radio默认状态
输出模式默认选中'拆分成单图给下游'

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const packRadio = radios.find(r => { const t = (r.textContent || '').trim(); return t.includes('打包') || t.includes('多张图'); }); if (!packRadio) return { noPackOption: true }; const radioInput = packRadio.querySelector('input[type=radio]'); if (radioInput) { radioInput.click(); return { clickedPack: true, label: (packRadio.textContent || '').trim() }; } return { noRadioInput: true }; })()
steps.description: 切换到'多张图打包在一起'模式

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const radioInfo = radios.map(r => { const label = (r.textContent || '').trim(); const checked = !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked'); return { label, checked }; }); const nowChecked = radioInfo.find(r => r.checked); return { radios: radioInfo, nowChecked: nowChecked ? nowChecked.label : null, packChecked: nowChecked ? nowChecked.label.includes('打包') : false }; })()
steps.description: 验证切换后'多张图打包在一起'已选中
切换后'多张图打包在一起'已选中

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const singleRadio = radios.find(r => { const t = (r.textContent || '').trim(); return t.includes('拆分') || t.includes('单图'); }); if (!singleRadio) return { noSingleOption: true }; const radioInput = singleRadio.querySelector('input[type=radio]'); if (radioInput) { radioInput.click(); return { clickedSingle: true, label: (singleRadio.textContent || '').trim() }; } return { noRadioInput: true }; })()
steps.description: 切换回'拆分成单图给下游'模式

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return false; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const ratioItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('比例') || label.includes('生图比例'); }); if (!ratioItem) return false; const sel = ratioItem.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { sel.setAttribute('data-testid', 'ratio-select'); return true; } return false; })()

steps.description: 点击生图比例Select展开下拉

steps.expression: return (() => { const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); const visibleDropdown = Array.from(dropdowns).find(d => { const rect = d.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width > 50 && rect.height > 30; }); if (!visibleDropdown) return { dropdownFound: false }; const options = Array.from(visibleDropdown.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')); const optionTexts = options.map(o => (o.querySelector('.ant-select-item-option-content')?.textContent || o.textContent || '').trim()); return { dropdownFound: true, ratioOptions: optionTexts.slice(0, 20), optionCount: options.length }; })()
steps.description: 枚举生图比例下拉选项
生图比例至少2个选项(含3:4)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return false; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const sizeItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('尺寸') || label.includes('图片尺寸'); }); if (!sizeItem) return false; const sel = sizeItem.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { sel.setAttribute('data-testid', 'size-select'); return true; } return false; })()

steps.description: 点击图片尺寸Select展开下拉

steps.expression: return (() => { const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); const visibleDropdown = Array.from(dropdowns).find(d => { const rect = d.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width > 50 && rect.height > 30; }); if (!visibleDropdown) return { dropdownFound: false }; const options = Array.from(visibleDropdown.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')); const optionTexts = options.map(o => (o.querySelector('.ant-select-item-option-content')?.textContent || o.textContent || '').trim()); return { dropdownFound: true, sizeOptions: optionTexts.slice(0, 20), optionCount: options.length }; })()
steps.description: 枚举图片尺寸下拉选项
图片尺寸至少1个选项(含1K)

steps.label: image_gen-output-mode
steps.description: 输出模式切换及比例尺寸验证截图

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = (inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (label.includes('seller')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } } return { open: true, filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); const urls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"']+(?:\.jpg|\.png|\.webp|\.jpeg)/gi) || []; const allUrls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<]+/gi) || []; return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError, imageUrlCount: urls.length, allUrlCount: allUrls.length, textPreview: text.substring(0, 200) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在含生图节点的策略(10602)
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 输出模式Radio: '拆分成单图给下游（默认）'/'多张图打包在一起'; 生图比例Select默认3:4(可能含1:1/16:9等); 图片尺寸Select默认1K(可能含2K/4K等)
riskPoints: Radio切换是否实时生效(无需额外确认)
切换输出模式是否影响下游节点数据格式
生图比例Select是否包含3:4选项
图片尺寸Select是否包含1K选项
切换后保存再打开是否持久化
